body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adjusts the monorepo’s Changesets/release configuration to prevent minor releases in a fixed group from incorrectly escalating to a major version due to internal peerDependency version churn, and documents the fix.

**Changes:**
- Enabled Changesets’ experimental `onlyUpdatePeerDependentsWhenOutOfRange` option to reduce peer-dependent bump propagation.
- Updated `@object-ui/plugin-designer` to treat internal `@object-ui/*` packages as `dependencies` (keeping only `react`/`react-dom` as peers).
- Added an Unreleased changelog entry describing the release-versioning guardrail.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/plugin-designer/package.json` | Moves internal `@object-ui/*` from `peerDependencies` to `dependencies` to avoid peerDependency-driven major bump detection. |
| `.changeset/config.json` | Adds `___experimentalUnsafeOptions_WILL_CHANGE_IN_PATCH.onlyUpdatePeerDependentsWhenOutOfRange: true` to prevent unnecessary peer-dependent updates. |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Documents the release bump escalation fix under Unreleased → Fixed. |
